description: Get structured search-engine results (organic listings, ads and related data) from Google, Bing or DuckDuckGo, as the engine ranks them. Use action=search (default) to run a query, or action=history to read earlier SERP queries for your account; prefer alterlab_search when you also want each result page read. Cost: $0.004 per query.
